subject: Concealing cables and equipment
hook: My TV is already on the wall. Is it too late to hide the cables?
fb:
Upgrading the TV before the Christmas films start? A question we hear a lot at this time of year: 'Our TV is already on the wall. Is it too late to hide the cables?'

Often it is not. A media wall or TV unit can be built with a void behind it that carries the cables from the screen down to the equipment, without anyone needing to chase into your plaster. If the sockets are in the wrong place, your electrician can move them before we fit.

Send us a photo of your current setup and we will tell you what is possible, or arrange a free consultation here:
https://superiofurniture.com/contact/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=entertaining-spaces-and-pre-christmas-planning&utm_content=day-077
gbp:
My TV is already wall-mounted. Can the cables still be hidden?

In many homes, yes. Rather than chasing cables into the wall, a SUPERIO media wall or TV unit can be designed with a void behind it. The void carries cables from the screen down to the equipment area, and a removable access panel lets you reach them later.

The TV may need to come down while the unit is fitted, and if the sockets are not where the equipment will sit, your own electrician can move them beforehand. We will point out exactly where they should go at the consultation.

If you are planning a new TV or rearranging the living room for hosting this winter, now is a good time to plan the setup. Media walls are made to measure in our Hanley workshop and installed by our own team across Stoke-on-Trent and Staffordshire.

Bring photos of your current setup to a free, no-obligation consultation. Tap below to book.
cta: Send a photo of your setup or book a consultation
